description:
Make snapshot export resolve its source commit, origin URL, branch and dirtiness through the git module instead of libgit2.

## Background

- `determine_snapshot_source_mode` (`crates/jit/src/commands/snapshot.rs:47-80`) opens libgit2 to resolve `--at` or `HEAD`. Without a repository, `--at` and `--committed-only` fail and the default falls back to the working tree.
- `get_repo_info` (`crates/jit/src/commands/snapshot.rs:352-392`) opens libgit2 for the origin URL (`origin_remote_url`, `crates/jit/src/commands/snapshot.rs:19-23`), the branch (`current_branch_name`, `crates/jit/src/commands/snapshot.rs:25-29`: `HEAD` when detached, none on an unborn branch) and dirtiness (`statuses(None)` non-empty, which with libgit2's default options includes ignored files).
- The module offers `resolve_commit`, `origin_url`, `head` with its branch label, and `dirty_paths`.
- The unit test `test_git_metadata_extracts_remote_and_branch_with_fallible_text_accessors` (`crates/jit/src/commands/snapshot.rs:1075`) builds its repository through git2.
- Kept as one change for a build reason: `origin_remote_url` and `current_branch_name` are private, and uncalled private functions fail the zero-warning build.

## Success Criteria

- [hard] REQ-01: Source mode resolves commits with `GitCheckout::resolve_commit` on the executor's git checkout; without a checkout, `--at` and `--committed-only` fail and the default falls back to the working tree, as today.
- [hard] REQ-02: Repository info takes the origin URL from `origin_url`, the branch from the head lookup's branch label (absent on an unborn branch), and dirtiness from the dirty-path query being non-empty.
- [hard] REQ-03: A test asserts the behaviour change and fails on today's code: a checkout whose only difference from `HEAD` is an ignored file exports as clean.
- [hard] REQ-04: `origin_remote_url` and `current_branch_name` no longer exist, and the unit test builds its repository with the shared git repository fixture.

## Notes

- Behaviour change: ignored files no longer make a snapshot's repository dirty.
- Written against the code as it stands after the changes this one follows; line citations name current code.
title: Snapshot source and repository facts come from the module
